title: Every Space gets a public address hello@<slug>.frequencylocal.com that receives into Conversations and sends as the Space
detail: BUILT 2026-10-12 (switch off). Owner ruling 2026-10-12: every account that messages through Frequency can have a reply address at their Space, like hello@<slug>.frequencylocal.com; premium can use its own domain. Table space_inbox_addresses (migration 20270346008400, service-only, pgTAP supabase/tests/space_inbox_addresses.test.sql). Provisioning lib/comms/space-inbox-address.ts: Resend domain <slug>.<SPACE_EMAIL_INBOX_ROOT> with receiving on (lib/spaces/email-domain-provider.ts createEmailProviderInboxDomain, findEmailProviderDomainByName), its MX/SPF/DKIM written into the root zone by lib/sites/vercel-domains.ts upsertZoneDnsRecords, row stored before DNS, idempotent, never throws; checkSpaceInboxAddress re-reads the provider. Inbound: lib/comms/inbound.ts resolves the Space address BEFORE the EMAIL-013 alias; a verified address opens a NEW Space conversation with the sender as a contact (consent unknown, source space_inbox); unknown, pending, failed or paused quarantines (inbox_address_unknown / inbox_address_unverified). Outbound: resolveSpaceEmailDefaultIdentity falls back to the verified inbox From for conversations on every plan (custom identity still wins; campaigns unchanged). Surface: the Your Space address card on Space Settings > Email (components/spaces/email/space-inbox-address-setup.tsx, actions app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/settings/email/inbox-actions.ts), hidden while SPACE_INBOX_ADDRESSES_ENABLED is off. Switches and gate: .env.example, docs/RUNBOOKS.md Space inbox address (EMAIL-022). OPEN until: the migration is applied, SPACE_EMAIL_INBOX_ROOT and the Vercel DNS token are set for the frequencylocal.com zone, the Resend account webhook carries email.received, the pilot on the Daniel Tyack Space receives one outside mail into a new conversation and replies from hello@<slug>.frequencylocal.com, and the switch is on in production with that evidence appended here. FINISHES ON ITS OWN 2026-10-13 (owner ruling: no one ever presses Check again): cron app/api/cron/space-inbox-verify (every 15 minutes, vercel.json, CRON_SECRET gate, heartbeat wrapper, CRON_UNMONITORED on the full 20-check plan) takes up to 25 pending rows and failed rows younger than 24h per run, oldest updated_at first (listSpaceInboxAddressesToFinish): a row with dns_written_at null is provisioned again, one with it set is checked; a row that errors is logged and skipped, never the batch; switch off answers skipped. Migration 20270346008500_space_inbox_addresses_dns_written_at.sql adds dns_written_at (set when upsertZoneDnsRecords returns ok, cleared when it fails; pgTAP updated). upsertZoneDnsRecords now returns Vercel's code AND message (bounded to 200 chars) and logs each refusal at warn with the zone and record name (lib/sites/vercel-domains.test.ts). The card says a pending address finishes on its own and the page can be left; Check again stays. Runbook: what to read when a row sticks in pending.

verify.evidence: OPEN. Probe runs the pure core (address, matcher, zone records, state, From) and reads the inbound-before-alias and From-fallback seams; vitest lib/comms/space-inbox-address.test.ts (provisioning idempotence and fail-safe, routing, recording), lib/comms/inbound-space-inbox.test.ts (webhook branch), lib/spaces/email-domain-onboarding.test.ts (From fallback) pass locally. Not yet observed: the migration in production, a real Resend domain reaching verified, a real inbound mail, the switch on. The probe closes only when this evidence carries "SWITCH ON IN PRODUCTION <date>" and "PILOT OBSERVED". 2026-10-12 pilot, first run: migration applied; frequencylocal.com DNS is at GoDaddy, so `space` was delegated by NS to ns1/ns2.vercel-dns.com and SPACE_EMAIL_INBOX_ROOT=space.frequencylocal.com set with the switch on in Production (card shown, Resend domain danieltyack.space.frequencylocal.com created, row saved pending). The DNS write failed twice over: Resend returned names relative to the registrable domain (send.danieltyack.space) and the mapping appended the slug again (send.danieltyack.space.danieltyack), and Vercel answered forbidden for the subzone because it keeps one zone per registrable domain and refuses a subdomain as a domain (POST /v7/domains invalid_name). Fixed in code: providerRecordHost resolves apex-relative names, spaceInboxZone writes into the apex zone, provisioning re-reads records from the provider on every run. Still to observe after that ships: the retry writes the records, Resend reaches verified, one inbound mail, one reply. 2026-10-13: the finisher cron, the dns_written_at column and the Vercel error message shipped (vitest app/api/cron/space-inbox-verify/route.test.ts, lib/comms/space-inbox-address.test.ts, lib/sites/vercel-domains.test.ts). Migration 20270346008500 NOT YET APPLIED in production at the time of writing; apply it before the next pilot run, then watch the pilot row reach verified with no button press.
